observation: A completed GUT receipt may declare both triageClassification and classification. Current qualification selects triageClassification with an OR fallback and does not compare the two declarations. If both are present and disagree, the contradictory alias is silently discarded and the receipt can still select a bounded decomposition profile.
risk: A self-contradictory metabolic diagnosis can be converted into false certainty, changing downstream VAJRA routing instead of remaining quarantined/HOLD.

reproduction.expected: receipt rejected as classification-alias-conflict; zero facets; no target selection when it is the only purported qualifier
reproduction.current: triageClassification wins and receipt qualifies as PROVENANCE_COLLISION

provenance.source: static inspection of nostromo/vajra/dynamic-decomposition.js plus synthetic de-identified adversarial fixture

promotionBoundary: Do not promote a classification-alias guard until a failing adversarial case is added, the receipt qualifier rejects contradictory dual classification declarations without suppressing genuine cross-receipt disagreement, existing replay/provenance/multiparent regressions pass, and GitHub Actions integration succeeds.
